chordplay.description:
​A customized downstream fork of BitChord with modular settings, custom lyrics fonts, and UI enhancements. 

ChordPlay is a modern, high-performance music client designed for listeners who care about both audio quality and visual craft. Engineered with Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform, ChordPlay combines the extensive streaming catalog of YouTube Music with a fluid, tactile interface inspired by modern glassmorphic design systems.

ChordPlay is built upon the open-source foundation of BitChord by Kushagra Singh, taking its proven streaming and audio architecture and transforming the user experience with custom-crafted UI layers, interactive live settings previews, dynamic theming engines, and refined motion ergonomics.
